sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain in a strong position and will be heavy favourites against Alsager, who sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and have won only once all season.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture between sides separated by 9 points, with Stafford looking to maintain pressure on leaders Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a meeting of two strong performers—Bridgnorth currently third with 19 points despite recent losses, while Eccleshall sit fifth on 18 points and have won their last outing. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth on 19 points and in good form with three wins in their last five, play away at Wednesfield Community, who are mid-table with 13 points. Bilston Town (sixth, 17 points) travel to face Foley Meir (11th, 11 points), while Barnton host Shawbury United—the latter in alarming form with six consecutive losses and just 10 points. Market Drayton Town (10th, 12 points) entertain New Mills (8th, 14 points), and Crewe face Allscott Heath in a fixture between lower-mid-table sides. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a bottom-half encounter between struggling sides, and Brereton Social (11th, 11 points) host Widnes Town (bottom, 2 points). Brereton Social also have a midweek fixture at home to Wednesfield Community on Wednesday 7 October at 19:45.
